title: Artemisia absinthium tincture for medicinal use
intro: Artemisia absinthium tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made from the dried leaves and flowers of the wormwood plant. It is traditionally used in herbalism for its purported digestive and detoxifying properties. The tincture is often employed to support liver function and aid in the treatment of digestive disorders. It may also be used in small doses to help alleviate symptoms of malaria. However, due to its potency and potential for toxicity, it should be used with caution and under the guidance of a qualified herbalist.
